TimeInterval.description: Inclusive UTC bounds established by independently trusted clock/native evidence, including measurement uncertainty; earliest must not exceed latest. The evidence is retained and authenticated by its receiving owner. An asserted timestamp or evidence digest alone does not authenticate time. For a Snapshot this bounds recoverable data time and is immutable; for an assessment it bounds the independently observed current time.

RecoveryPointAssessment.description: A deterministic protection assessment over the complete independently authenticated checkpoint Snapshot set and an independently supplied current clock interval. The oldest per-dataset bounds govern, without claiming application atomicity. Lower age is rounded down, upper age up; within-objective requires upper <= rpo_seconds and exceeded requires lower > rpo_seconds. Missing data-time/clock evidence, uncertain temporal order, or bounds straddling the objective yield unknown. When age cannot be established both age fields are null. Receipt verified_at, backup verification, retry, restore and drill completion cannot refresh data age. This result is an observation/warning only, not admission authority or a new admission block; later use requires a new current-time assessment.
